selector.rationale: The Holter monitor recording showed a 23.8-second ventricular asystole during syncope with gradual slowing of the sinus rate and atrioventricular conduction followed by complete atrioventricular block, which is consistent with VP-AVB.

rejected.label: Sick Sinus Syndrome
rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence in the vignette

rejected.label: Atrioventricular Block
rejected.why: Too general, VP-AVB is a more specific diagnosis supported by the evidence

support_spans: Holter monitor recording:    Image Title: Patient Electrocardiogram Recorded by Holter Monitor During Syncope    Image Description: Recording showed a 23.8-second ventricular asystole during syncope.
The rhythm strip demonstrated gradual slowing of the sinus rate and atrioventricular conduction followed by complete atrioventricular block.
Asystole derived from gradually extended PR and PP intervals and was transiently suspended by a spontaneous junctional escape beat.
